evidence.title: From Agent Behaviour to Agent-Friendly Documentation: An Empirical Study of How Coding Agents Discover, Read, and Write Technical Documentation

summary: Researchers conducted an empirical investigation into the behavior of coding agents, analyzing how they locate, interpret, and generate technical documentation. The findings highlight patterns that can inform the design of more agent-friendly documentation practices.
title: Study Shows How Coding Agents Discover, Read, and Write Technical Documentation
